thread_text:
Priya Patel: Quick triage request — Lumos-65B candidate for onboarding. FP16 baseline looks OK, but initial 4-bit experiments show quality regressions on commonsense. Can we run a fast priority check today and decide go/no-go for a canary?

Samir Cho: I'll run the lightweight scoring harness: cost, latency, quality delta vs FP16, regression risk. Can start evals for the 5 suites now.

Anika Bose: I can own quant experiments (PTQ, QAT, and LLM.int8 if supported). Early note: naive 4-bit had multi-hop hallucinations in small sample. I'll try LLama2-style QAT and a PTQ+calibration run.

Devon Lee: Infra note — we have a free window on gpu-pool-dedicated-2 tomorrow 06:00-18:00 UTC. Need to build a new image with updated kernels for the model and quant kernels if QAT runs.

QuantBot: Snapshot: FP16 perf = 52 tok/s, p95 latency 180ms. Naive 4-bit perf = 84 tok/s, p95 220ms. Quick eval delta (commonsense-v1) = -6.8% accuracy vs FP16.

Priya Patel: Proposed quick rubric (weights + scale):
```
weights: cost=20, latency=20, quality=40, regression_risk=20
scale: 0-10 each
pass_threshold: weighted >= 7.5
```
Plan: Samir run baseline evals; Anika run PTQ and QAT variants (q4/q5 if available); Devon coordinate infra; flag >3% commonsense drop as canary-blocker.

Samir Cho: Launching: `./eval_harness --model lumos-65b --suites commonsense,generation,dialog,math,qa --out /tmp/lumos65b-eval-194210` ETA ~2.5h

Anika Bose: Will queue QAT once baseline is in. If PTQ looks bad but QAT helps, we should prefer QAT for initial canary.

Devon Lee: I'll prepare image: `docker build -t rwinf/lumos65b:2026-03-20 -f infra/Dockerfile .` and reserve gpu-pool-dedicated-2 for 12h starting 06:00 UTC tomorrow. Noted QAT needs ~12h.

Samir Cho: Baseline done. Quick scores: cost=8, latency=7, quality=6.2 (commonsense down), regression_risk=7. Weighted = 6.64 -> below threshold.

Priya Patel: Borderline. Tasks:
- Samir: add prompt-sensitivity tests for commonsense examples
- Anika: run PTQ + QAT (q4/q5) and report per-suite deltas
- Devon: confirm infra reservation & deploy image
If QAT brings weighted >=7.5, we move to canary.

Anika Bose: QAT q4 started (config attached to job). I'll also log KV-cache traces — quant can alter attention timing.

Samir Cho: Added prompt-sensitivity tests. Noted a subset of long-context prompts cause larger drops; will include examples in the report.

QuantBot: QAT q4 finished. Perf: 78 tok/s, p95 210ms. Commonsense delta vs FP16: -1.1%. Recomputed weighted score = 7.9.

Priya Patel: Good — exceeds 7.5. Decision: proceed to canary. Canary plan: 1% traffic, monitor quality gates (per-suite thresholds, alert on >1% regression for commonsense or >2% for generation BLEU), 48h watch.

Devon Lee: Canary window scheduled: Wed 03:00-07:00 UTC. Canary route + rollback hooks configured. I'll post the deploy job and healthchecks. Canary will auto-rollback on failed gates.

Samir Cho: I'll publish a short eval dashboard (per-prompt diffs, top regressions, examples) and set regression alerts. Will attach urls in the canary ticket.

Anika Bose: I'll add quant config, training script snippet, and tuning notes to the model card. Also include the seed/commit for reproducibility.

Priya Patel: Owners: Samir (eval + dashboard), Anika (quant config & model card), Devon (infra + deploy). I'll open the canary rollout PR linking the model card and eval artifacts. Thanks everyone :rocket:

Samir Cho: Dropping a few failing prompts to track in the ticket.

Priya Patel: Resolving this thread for now. Ping if the canary trips or we need rollback.
